title: Session: 2.37.0 build and deploy an environment
objective: One main-branch workflow builds the image, reconciles the selected Linode, configures AlmaLinux 10 and deploys rootless Podman. The selected environment supplies all settings and one production approval. No bot behavior or schema change; the live Compose path stays until owner cutover.
user: Review the pipeline change and migrate infrastructure settings into the selected environment; agents change no environments or cloud resources.
Use prepare_only to prove a new production host and encrypted backup, stop the incumbent bot, then dispatch normal deployment with runtime secrets.
assistant: Verify source, pipeline failure paths, OpenTofu mocks, Ansible syntax/lint and the documentation build without live credentials.
Keep the Compose production files and workflow jobs byte-identical, and record limitations and owner setup.
bot: Continue serving the current deployment until the owner completes the transition.
Post this session plan in the configured test channel after the authorized deployment.
